insights_perDayHint.message: Time on a site counts only while its tab is active, the window has focus and you are not idle. Click a day to see it on its own.

insights_noData.message: No browsing time recorded for this period.

insights_noSites.message: Nothing yet. Browse as usual and check back later.

insights_privacy.message: Insights stay on this device. FocusGuard stores only domains, durations and counts per day — never page content, form data or full URLs. Data older than 120 days is removed automatically.
